joinMovement.title: Why we're building Konectr
joinMovement.quote: We're tired of likes that don't lead to real laughs, of followers who'll never follow you on a real adventure.
joinMovement.quoteHighlight: Konectr isn't another app to scroll through
joinMovement.quoteEnd: — it's your ticket out of the digital loop and into real life.
joinMovement.author: — The Konectr Team
